description: Named the lost hour, the Mayor's door, the loaf, and the threepence, and denied the dropped voice.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Left by the south door from three rows ahead, and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Named in the attempt. Not in the room.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Heard, as the playing. Not named, and not seen as a face.
name: the lady of the parish

description: Made the cross and did not gloss it.
name: William Shakespeare
